problem: Every student in the class passed. Amal is a student in the class. Conclusion: Amal passed. Does the conclusion necessarily follow from the premises? Answer Yes or No.

theorem final_wf : ∀ (S P : Fin 3 → Bool), (∀ x, S x → P x) → S Amal → P Amal := by sorry
theorem final_pos : ∀ (S P : Fin 3 → Bool), (∀ x, S x → P x) → S Amal → P Amal := by fv_auto
theorem final_neg : ¬ (∀ (S P : Fin 3 → Bool), (∀ x, S x → P x) → S Amal → P Amal) := by fv_auto
